note: Authoritative, machine-checked manifest of the compliance-workflow required status checks. Branch protection is a GitHub REPO SETTING that cannot be changed from code — this file is the source of truth a maintainer copies into Settings → Branches → main → 'Require status checks to pass before merging'. scripts/check-close-out.mjs fails CI if the set of jobs in .github/workflows/compliance.yml drifts from requiredChecks (a new compliance job that is not registered here, or a stale entry here with no job), so the manual repo setting can never silently fall behind the workflow. The setting is confirmed and recorded as EV-BRANCH-PROTECTION in the control register.
requiredChecks: CI group (Legal · Accessibility and Product) — electoral output
CI group (Privacy and Research · Accessibility and Product) — age-first gate
CI group (Legal · Accessibility and Product) — candidate/party distinction
CI group (Privacy and Research · Accessibility and Product) — local-device privacy
CI group (Privacy and Research · Infrastructure and Operations) — privacy claims + transport

disclaimers.note: The Terms of Use state the operator's published terms are 'not legal advice'. This disclaimer does NOT stand in for a control: the substantive backing is the versioned-Terms incorporation + internal-consistency control (scripts/check-terms.mjs) and the legal-review freshness / qualified-practitioner sign-off gate (scripts/check-legal-review.mjs) which requires an Australian practitioner's review before an election.

The card notice 'How2Vote does not recommend a candidate or a preference order', the generated-page prose 'How2Vote does not recommend a candidate or party' (content.server.ts — replacing the earlier absolute 'non-partisan' self-label per the 2026-07-19 deep review), and the glossary's 'Alignment' definition (now in lib/content/glossary.ts, the single term list rendered by both the /glossary page and the in-place definition popover) ('background information, not a recommendation — How2Vote never tells you who to put first') are backed by real controls, not merely asserted: the neutrality / non-recommendation claims register + methodology binding (scripts/check-neutrality-claims.mjs) bans absolute / recommendation / preselection copy, and the user-authored blank-ballot design means every preference box starts empty and the voter authors the order themselves.
